personScope.rule: Name-source labels describe naming data and usage history; they do not determine a person’s gender identity, personality, occupation, appearance, or relationships.

purpose: Lossless name-data preservation from all attached baby-name generator repositories. allExactNames preserves source spellings/case exactly; activePools provides deduplicated generator-ready display names.

negativeTrainingRowsExcluded.reason: Rows with target=0 are explicitly non-name negative classifier examples, not baby names.

sourceUsagePolicy: Female/male/neutral pools are historical/source naming buckets only; they never restrict person gender identity.
